decisions.reason: As the flagship of the newer music-box direction, it is less traditional for the firm but surviving several seasons suggests enough strategic and commercial value to retain it for now.
This Christmas-themed platform remains dependent on the electronic music-box line, yet its seasonal fit with the firm's core customer demand makes it worth keeping a bit longer.
A Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid sits squarely in the firm's established handcrafted strengths and is therefore the least likely of the remaining products to be withdrawn.
